architecture.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + Nolane UI (NUI) Editorial Bàn Giấy Design Tokens

database.productionConnection: A real PostgreSQL connection is mandatory in production; resolve DATABASE_URL first, then POSTGRES_URL, POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL, DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED, POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING. Never silently switch production to ephemeral PGlite.
database.poolingCompatibility: postgres.js uses prepare:false for transaction pooler compatibility.

architecture.nodeRuntime: Node.js 24.x in local/CI/Vercel. isomorphic-dompurify 4.5.0 uses a jsdom 25.0.1 override and Next serverExternalPackages to avoid serverless ESM bundling failures.

security.sessionTokens: 256-bit cryptographically secure, SHA-256 hashed in DB
security.rateLimiter: In-process sliding-window limiter capped at 20,000 keys; public read APIs apply global and per-route per-IP budgets before database access. The counter is not shared across serverless instances, so it is a best-effort abuse guard only; edge/WAF/distributed rules are required for uniform global limiting.
security.xssProtection: isomorphic-dompurify HTML sanitization plus recursive public DTO URL validation; executable schemes and protocol-relative URL destinations are filtered from navigation, metadata, resources, projects and nested page blocks/settings.
security.vaultEncryption: Client-side Web Crypto AES-256-GCM; PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 at 600000 iterations for new items, legacy 100000-iteration decryption fallback
security.panicLock: Global Ctrl+Shift+L privacy overlay with account re-authentication; not a secure RAM wipe or OS lock
security.aiDataFlow: Copilot API key is session/component state only; retrieval context is opt-in; external provider requests leave the browser and are subject to provider/network policies
security.publicApiCache: Database-backed public APIs and public explore-feed responses use private, no-store cache headers so a changed guest-password gate cannot be bypassed via a shared CDN entry. Public explore data uses a fixed allow-list of six upstream APIs, server-side Next.js fetch revalidation for five minutes, bounded JSON payloads, timeout, per-IP rate limiting, guest-password enforcement, and a five-minute bounded browser cache.
security.publicUrlSerialization: Public URL fields are validated with scheme, control-character, credential, protocol-relative and size checks; bounded base64 raster images are the only allowed data URLs.
security.dependencyAudit: npm audit --omit=dev reports zero known production dependency vulnerabilities. The full development-tree audit still flags the braces 3.0.3 high-severity advisory in eslint-config-next fast-glob/micromatch; registry has no patched braces release yet, so it remains dev-only and is tracked rather than hidden.
security.authResponseCache: All /api/auth/* endpoints receive Cache-Control no-store, Pragma no-cache and Vary: Cookie headers.

ciCd.productionDependencyAudit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate runs in CI after npm ci and before lint/typecheck/tests/build.

functionalStatus.copilot: Shared multi-provider AI catalog with OpenAI-compatible presets (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Mistral, Together, Fireworks, xAI, Cerebras, Perplexity, Cohere, NVIDIA NIM, SambaNova, SiliconFlow, Hugging Face, DeepInfra, Hyperbolic, Novita, Nebius), native Anthropic Messages, Ollama, LM Studio/vLLM/llama.cpp/LiteLLM and custom compatible endpoints; supports model-list discovery where available, manual model IDs, URL validation, per-request timeout and direct-browser requests. AI Workbench and Creator Studio now persist provider/model/endpoint preferences and bounded recent chat history locally; API keys remain session-only unless the owner explicitly enables device-local remembrance, then AES-GCM encrypted data is stored in IndexedDB, not localStorage or the website database. Credentials are not synchronized between browsers/devices, and local persistence does not protect against XSS or a compromised browser session. Personal-data retrieval remains keyword-based, not full RAG or agent runtime.
functionalStatus.workflows: Persistent workflow definitions and durable run history. Preflight compiler validates DAGs and true/false branches; allowlisted node executor supports Inbox/task reads, idempotent task create/reuse, Inbox conversion and read-only overdue reporting with per-node traces. Inbox conversion is transactional/row-locked and protected by a partial unique index. Daily Vercel Cron executes only recognized legacy overdue reports or DAGs composed entirely of allowlisted read-only overdue operations; custom graphs with write operations fail closed and record their failure. Candidates already claimed for the Vietnam day are filtered before the 50-workflow batch limit to prevent starvation. Arbitrary shell/code, AI and approval actions are not enabled. CRON_SECRET is required in production.
functionalStatus.creatorStudio: Database-backed content pipeline and optional direct AI outline generation; per-provider model/endpoint preferences persist locally and API-key remembrance is explicitly opt-in and encrypted in browser IndexedDB. External publishing is not implemented by this module.
functionalStatus.calendarHabits: Owner-scoped database-backed events and habits with strict ISO/date/timezone and size validation, bounded pagination, and 64 KiB request caps. Habit completion uses per-day desired-state updates inside a row-locked transaction, retries are idempotent, and generic habit patches reject whole-array history replacement to prevent concurrent lost updates. UI supports incremental loading, all-day events, event editing, habit pause/resume and explicit request failures; external calendar sync remains unimplemented.
functionalStatus.backups: JSON export with SHA-256 data integrity manifest and per-module counts across 27 groups including workflow run history; import preview verifies checksum without writes, warns for legacy backups and requires explicit acknowledgement before additive transactional restore. Import body bytes are capped while streaming at 4.5 MiB instead of buffering an unchecked request; checksum authenticity signatures and replacement-style restore remain unsupported.
functionalStatus.audioLab: Procedural multi-layer Web Audio mixer with independent per-layer/master gain and spectrum from AnalyserNode. Per-layer, master and radio volumes are validated and saved locally; closing the app stops audio, while reopening restores volumes without surprise autoplay. External radio remains third-party and failures are surfaced.
functionalStatus.wallpaperStudio: Wallpaper library list uses a metadata-only query that excludes the multi-megabyte localDataUrl column and returns a local-asset flag. The selected uploaded image/video is loaded through the owner-scoped /api/admin/wallpapers/:id endpoint only when needed; favorite and metadata updates never select or resend the full asset. Active selection, filters and shader persist by ID without changing the chosen settings after reopen.
functionalStatus.htmlSanitization: Shared DOMPurify HTML sanitizer is covered by regression tests; jsdom is pinned and externalized for the Node serverless runtime to prevent API route import crashes.
functionalStatus.publicTools: Public /tools is an account-free Knowledge Portal and Open Data Lab, not a public calculator. Cooldown display updates once per second to reduce unnecessary full-page renders. The guest view does not render the owner scientific calculator or unit converter; calculator remains private at /admin/calculator and the authenticated owner desktop/Dock/Omni palette. Six on-demand direct-browser feeds provide up to 8 Hugging Face text-generation models, 8 GitHub topic:llm repositories, 8 recent Hacker News AI discussions, 8 HLE leaderboard rows, 8 Europe PMC research metadata records, and 8 GitHub Global Security Advisories. The portal also has a curated reference directory for AI/models/datasets, scientific research, cybersecurity, open-source software, public datasets/statistics, web standards, learning and technology communities. HLE entries preserve score/rank, notes and source verified flag; community/unverified rows are explicitly labelled and not certified. Feed calls use no website backend proxy or API credentials, a 10-second timeout, 180 KiB streamed response ceiling, a 45-second per-feed cooldown and 30-minute browser cache; no feed runs on page open. External metadata is normalized and trusted-source links are constructed from validated identifiers. Benchmark Hub links to Artificial Analysis, LMArena, Stanford HELM and Hugging Face without fabricating scores. Database-backed public GET APIs have per-process global/per-route budgets and always emit no-store across browser/CDN/Vercel because the guest-password gate is mutable. Unlisted-token responses are private/no-store. In-memory rate budgets are not distributed; provider-level WAF rules remain necessary for global DoS resistance.
functionalStatus.ownerSettingsPersistence: Durable owner preferences survive closing/reopening their app windows: AI provider/model/endpoint, opt-in encrypted API keys and recent bounded chat history; calculator expression/result/angle mode/history; Audio Lab per-layer/master/radio volumes; Focus Studio goal, countdown remaining time, session count and ambience volumes; active wallpaper, validated filters and shader. Repeated successful saves emit no duplicate global status events. Timer/audio playback itself does not auto-resume. Ctrl/Cmd+K selects one command palette for the active desktop/workspace mode, and Escape closes the current palette; keyboard regression tests cover both paths.
